<timestamp>Thursday, Nov 19, 2026, 4:23 PM (UTC-8)</timestamp>
<user_query>
I set up an account, if asked to demo are all the workflows live and running?
</user_query>
I’ll check the project and how its workflows are wired so I can tell you whether a demo would actually hit live, running flows.
The site treats a new account as empty until the bots actually report. I’ll check the live host and what “connected” means before saying whether a demo would run for real.

**No.** Creating a Waypoint account does not start the five bot workflows. The site itself is up at [waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com](https://waypoint-5o4r.onrender.com): the health check reports the database is on and texts are on. Your account’s deadlines are real. The bots are not running for that account until each one is installed in Grok Bot and has reported in.

If someone asks you to demo right now, use **Show me the demo** on the sign-in page. That opens the sample people (Priya, then Wei). They already have sample runs, so the scripted path works without your account’s bots: change the mock portal status, run the simulated Case Clerk check, watch the Brief, approve the draft, then switch to Wei for H-1B. The free host sleeps after 15 idle minutes, so the first open can take up to a minute.

On your own account the Brief and day counts work, and **Check now** only runs a simulated Case Clerk and Manager. Intake Clerk, Scout, and Messenger stay **Not connected** until a real bot reports. The nightly 2:00 AM run lives on the Manager bot in Grok Bot, not on the server, so it is not running just because the account exists.

They are live only after you install all five templates from **Connect your Bots** (Manager first, with your key), then ask the Manager to “run the night now.” The Brief should then show a time under each bot, and the lines under Checked for you should not say simulated.
